Write on the envelope: APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ASHA FOR ... VILLAGE/SERVICE AREA UNDER ... HEALTH SUB-CENTRE.
Send by speed post or registered post to the Block Development Officer, Gosaba Development Block, Village Arampur, P.O. Arampur, P.S. Gosaba, South 24 Parganas, PIN 743370.
Application must reach the BDO office by 15-12-2026, 5 PM.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for BDO Gosaba Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in BDO Gosaba Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies: 1 ASHA - Amtali Gram panchayat office Sub Center (Amtali GP), 1 ASHA - Bali II Bijoynagar Sub Center (Bally II GP), 1 ASHA - Dulki Sub Center (Gosaba GP), 1 ASHA - Kamakshyapur Sub Center (Sambhunagar GP), 1 ASHA - Bhupendrapur Sub Center (Sambhunagar GP), 1 ASHA - Chhotomollakhali Rangapara Sub Center (Chhotomollakhali GP) and 2 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for BDO Gosaba Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-1 (application form) attached to the notice) and send it to The Block Development Officer, Gosaba Development Block, Village: Arampur, P.O.: Arampur, P.S.: Gosaba, Dist.: South 24 Parganas, PIN: 743370, by speed post or registered post, to reach by 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is between 30 and 40 years for General candidates; between 22 and 40 years for SC and ST candidates (as on 25 November 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST Age limit 22 to 40 years as on 25-11-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Honorarium based.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Must have appeared in Madhyamik or equivalent examination; candidates who did not pass Madhyamik or equivalent are also considered. Higher qualified candidates may apply, but only Madhyamik or equivalent marks are considered. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a permanent resident of the identified service area of the concerned village; proof by voter ID and ration card. Only one application per candidate.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Women who are not married, widowed or divorced by court decree. A candidate submitting more than one application: all her applications are cancelled.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview. Eligible candidates are informed by post of the interview date, time and venue. Originals of certificates (a) to (f) must be shown on the interview day. Marks obtained in Madhyamik or equivalent are considered; higher qualification gives no extra benefit.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: ASHA engagement is on a contract basis.
